rows.en: Module 1: Overview of Mental Health and Psychosocial Support​
rows.ne: मोड्युल 1: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोगको झलक
rows.bt: Module 1: An overview of mental health and psychosocial support
rows.note: Uses the supplied unreviewed MHPSS terminology candidate.

rows.en: Define mental health and psychosocial wellbeing
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याणको परिभाषा दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Define mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: Learning objective, not a validated instrument item.

rows.en: Understand the determinants of mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याण निर्धारण गर्ने कारकहरू बुझ्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Understand the factors that determine mental health and psychosocial well-being.

rows.en: Describe how humanitarian crises impact mental health and psychosocial wellbeing
rows.ne: मानवीय सङ्कटहरूले मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याणमा कसरी असर पार्छन् भन्ने वर्णन गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Describe how humanitarian crises affect mental health and psychosocial well-being.

rows.en: Define mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS)
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग (MHPSS) को परिभाषा दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Define mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS).
Understand the cluster system of humanitarian assistance.

rows.en: Mental health: A state of (psychological) well-being (not merely the absence of mental disorder) in which every individual realises his or her own potential, can cope with the normal stresses of life, can work productively and fruitfully, and is able to make a contribution to her or his community.
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य: (मनोवैज्ञानिक) कल्याणको यस्तो अवस्था (मानसिक विकारको अभाव मात्र होइन), जसमा प्रत्येक व्यक्तिले आफ्नो क्षमता साकार पार्छ, जीवनका सामान्य तनावहरूको सामना गर्न सक्छ, उत्पादनशील र फलदायी रूपमा काम गर्न सक्छ र आफ्नो समुदायमा योगदान दिन सक्षम हुन्छ।
rows.bt: Mental health: Such a state of (psychological) well-being (not merely the absence of mental disorder), in which each person realizes their capacity, can cope with the normal stresses of life, can work productively and fruitfully and is able to contribute to their community.
rows.note: Unvalidated definition draft preserving the distinction between well-being and mere absence of disorder, together with each stated capability.
Opening citation fragment; the source opening parenthesis is retained.

rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य: हाम्रो प्रतिकार्य सुदृढ बनाउने।
rows.note: Translated publication title, not a clinical definition.
Closing citation fragment; WHO and 2016 are preserved.

rows.en: Mental Health & Psychosocial Support (MHPSS): any type of local or outside support that aims to protect or promote psychosocial wellbeing and/or prevent or treat mental disorders.
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग (MHPSS): मनोसामाजिक कल्याणको संरक्षण वा प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने र/वा मानसिक विकारहरूको रोकथाम वा उपचार गर्ने उद्देश्य भएको कुनै पनि प्रकारको स्थानीय वा बाह्य सहयोग।
rows.bt: Mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS): Any type of local or external support that has the purpose of protecting or promoting psychosocial well-being and/or preventing or treating mental disorders.
rows.note: Unvalidated definition draft retaining any type of support, the local or outside distinction, and the source and/or relationship.

rows.en: (IASC 2007. Guidelines on MHPSS in Emergency Settings)
rows.note: Retain the source citation unchanged: (IASC 2007. Guidelines on MHPSS in Emergency Settings)

rows.en: The term ‘psychosocial’ denotes the interconnection between psychological and social processes, and the fact that each continually interacts with and influences the other.
rows.ne: ‘मनोसामाजिक’ शब्दले मनोवैज्ञानिक र सामाजिक प्रक्रियाहरूबीचको अन्तरसम्बन्ध तथा यी दुवैले निरन्तर एकअर्कासँग अन्तरक्रिया गर्ने र एकअर्कालाई प्रभाव पार्ने तथ्यलाई जनाउँछ।
rows.bt: The term ‘psychosocial’ refers to the interrelationship between psychological and social processes and the fact that these two continually interact with one another and influence one another.
rows.note: Unvalidated explanatory draft retaining the continuous, reciprocal interaction and influence between psychological and social processes.

rows.en: (IASC 2011. MHPSS in Emergency Settings: What Should Humanitarian Health Actors Know?)
